Vertex domination forces at least one selection on every arm; 3-step coverage plus center constraint yields U+eta. Center/first-depth exhaustive edge cases yield the three four-step ceilings; residue comparisons show equality iff every arm is 2 or 3 and some is 2. Independent all-subsets BFS and endpoint-min edge distances on (2,2,2),(2,3,4),(3,3,4),(2,5,6),(4,4,4) matched the pair of formulas. Unit arms and nonspiders excluded; finite tests are checks, not infinite proof.
